answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 42084 Country: United States of America Title: divorce Question: My husband is giving me a divorce because he said he no longer can live with me. Does that mean he can take all the gifts he gave me during/and after the wedding back. Who's properties are those gifts which he had gifted me. Is my husband supposed to give me my gifts back, or will I have no right on that Islamically? Answer ID: 42084 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1587/1009/L=1433) If all the gifts which your husband has given you were as hiba (gift) then you are the owner of those gifts. It shall not be right for your husband to take back all those gifts. Yes, if your husband borrowed you something then he shall have right to take it back. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
